title: Native image grow
description: The closed protocol of growing an existing fixed image to a larger declared size: the image is detached while no command uses it, its backing is stretched without writing a byte (the volume follows at the next attach), it is attached again and the receipt is rewritten. Only a machine with images (macOS) grows; a host that cannot hold the larger envelope is named unfit instead of retried.
